result.brief: 提出证据约束的自动驾驶3D世界建模框架，在线维护道路、占据与动态实体统一世界状态并做动作条件未来预测，离线用NeRF/3DGS重建并生成式扩展长尾场景，同时限制生成内容作为几何真值。
result.reason: Proposes evidence-constrained 3D world state with action-conditioned future prediction and generative simulation for driving; main contribution is driving world modeling/simulation application.
